CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(ELM_Fecha_cierre__c), CASE( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey), "es", "Abierto", /* Español */ "en_US", "Open", /* Inglés */ "zh_CN", "开放", /* Chino Simplificado */ "pt_BR", "Aberto", /* Portugués (Brasil) */ "Open" /* Valor por defecto */ ), IF( ADDMONTHS( ELM_Fecha_cierre__c, IF(TEXT(ELM_Line_Of_Business__c) = "GET", 60, 36) ) >= TODAY(), CASE( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey), "es", "Vigente", "en_US", "Active", "zh_CN", "有效", "pt_BR", "Válido", "Active" ), CASE( TEXT($User.LanguageLocaleKey), "es", "Caducado", "en_US", "Expired", "zh_CN", "已过期", "pt_BR", "Expirado", "Expired" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Estado Venta VAES
